collection_description: Tagged comments collected during Mathematical Center in Akademgorodok First Workshop; dataset page says comments are from VK and labels were guided by domain experts.

original_label_fields.decent: decent vs obscene; source-described mark for presence of obscene words
original_label_fields.person: person/imperson/imperson insult; source metadata kept in raw file

privacy_handling: Raw file contains text and VK source URLs and is locally ignored by Git. Derived experiment artifacts contain IDs, labels, hashes and aggregates only; obvious direct identifiers were filtered from model input. Streamlit dashboard does not display/download comments.
retrieval: Public Mendeley metadata and download endpoints; no account login or terms acceptance.
